tasks.name: Design Problem Repository UI
tasks.description: Create the frontend interface for browsing and searching programming problems.

tasks.name: Implement Problem Repository Backend
tasks.description: Develop the backend logic to store, retrieve, and manage programming problems.

tasks.name: Set Up Problem Repository Database
tasks.description: Design and implement the database schema for storing programming problems.

tasks.name: Develop Code Submission UI
tasks.description: Create the frontend interface for users to submit their code solutions.

tasks.name: Implement Code Evaluation Logic
tasks.description: Develop the backend logic to evaluate submitted code against test cases.

tasks.name: Design User Profile UI
tasks.description: Create the frontend interface for users to view and edit their profiles.

tasks.name: Implement User Profile Backend
tasks.description: Develop the backend logic to manage user profiles and their data.

tasks.name: Set Up User Profile Database
tasks.description: Design and implement the database schema for storing user profile information.

tasks.name: Develop Leaderboard UI
tasks.description: Create the frontend interface for displaying user rankings and scores.

tasks.name: Implement Leaderboard Backend
tasks.description: Develop the backend logic to calculate and update user rankings.

tasks.name: Develop Hints and Tutorials UI
tasks.description: Create the frontend interface for displaying hints and tutorials for problems.

tasks.name: Implement Hints and Tutorials Backend
tasks.description: Develop the backend logic to manage hints and tutorials for problems.

tasks.name: Set Up Hints and Tutorials Database
tasks.description: Design and implement the database schema for storing hints and tutorials.

tasks.name: Perform Frontend Testing
tasks.description: Test all frontend components for usability and functionality.

tasks.name: Perform Backend Testing
tasks.description: Test all backend components for correctness and performance.

tasks.name: Perform Database Testing
tasks.description: Test all database schemas and queries for correctness and efficiency.

tasks.name: Deploy ACM Problem-Solving Platform
tasks.description: Deploy the platform to a production environment.

T1.implementation_approach: Create a user-friendly interface with search, filter, and sorting options for problems.
T1.notes: Ensure responsive design for various devices.

T2.implementation_approach: Develop RESTful APIs to handle problem data retrieval, creation, and updates.

T3.implementation_approach: Set up a relational database schema to store problem details, tags, and metadata.

T4.implementation_approach: Design an intuitive UI for users to submit code and view submission results.
T4.notes: Include real-time feedback for submission status.

T5.implementation_approach: Implement logic to compile, execute, and evaluate code submissions against test cases.

T6.implementation_approach: Design a profile page to display user details, achievements, and activity history.

T7.implementation_approach: Develop backend APIs to manage user data, authentication, and profile updates.

T8.implementation_approach: Set up a database schema to store user profiles, preferences, and activity logs.

T9.implementation_approach: Create a leaderboard UI to display rankings based on user performance metrics.
T9.notes: Include filters for different criteria like time period or problem category.

T10.implementation_approach: Develop backend logic to calculate and update leaderboard rankings dynamically.

T11.implementation_approach: Design a UI to display hints and tutorials in an organized and accessible manner.
T11.notes: Include search functionality for easy navigation.

T12.implementation_approach: Develop APIs to manage hints and tutorials content, including retrieval and updates.

T13.implementation_approach: Set up a database schema to store hints, tutorials, and associated metadata.

T14.implementation_approach: Perform UI testing to ensure responsiveness, usability, and cross-browser compatibility.
T14.notes: Use automated tools like Selenium for efficiency.

T15.implementation_approach: Test backend APIs for functionality, performance, and security using tools like Postman.

T16.implementation_approach: Validate database schema, queries, and data integrity through unit and integration tests.
T16.notes: Test for edge cases and large datasets.

T17.implementation_approach: Deploy the platform on a cloud service with CI/CD pipelines for automated updates.
T17.notes: Ensure proper monitoring and logging post-deployment.
